explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration for this result. The theorem is built entirely on the library's own definitions: `FormalODModule`, `Rigidified`, `IsAdmissible`, `Series`, `reduceMap`, `HasKernelOfDegree` and `Zp2`. It lifts an admissible rigidification along a surjection of Noetherian rings whose kernel is nilpotent. I grepped Mathlib for `CerednikDrinfeld` and `FormalODModule` and got no hits, so Mathlib has none of the underlying definitions either. The proof combines several of the library's own lemmas (Katz-type lifting, kernel-degree lemmas, `RhoLift` lemmas) and does not apply any single Mathlib result.
